messages:
support-ana: Heads-up: AcmePay p95 up ~300ms after runtime v3.2.1 canary landed in us-east-1 this morning. Tickets piling up. Sample request IDs below.

ops-bot: Alert: latency_p95 > threshold for tenant=AcmePay (us-east-1). Graph: https://grafana.redwood/..../d/abc123 :eyes:

maya: Can you paste exact p95/p99 deltas and a quick repro curl? Any config flips in that canary?

support-ana: p95: 120ms -> 420ms, p99: 210ms -> 740ms. Only AcmePay so far. Canary included kernel-selector v2 + kv_cache_ttl=120. Repro:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"xsmall","input":"hi"}'
```
request ids: r_0a1b2c, r_0d3e4f

ivan: I rolled kernel-selector v2 to canary hosts this morning. It changed batching behavior and kv-cache read path; could amplify auth refresh misses that hit backend auth service.

lee: We saw a spike in token validation calls from that tenant around the same time. If token cache TTL doubled, more cache churn for short-lived tokens.

maya: Is the pattern many short requests or longer streams?

support-ana: Many tiny requests (avg tok=12). Looks like short request heavy cohort.

ivan: Mitigation idea 1: per-tenant kv-cache override (set AcmePay ttl back to 60). Mitigation 2: enable bypass_kvcache for a small subset to see cold-path impact. If no improvement, rollback kernel-selector.

maya: Can we flip the override without a deploy?

lee: Yes, config flag via runtime-config svc. I can set `kv_cache.ttl.override.acmepay=60` in 5m. Also can flip `kernel_selector=legacy` for canary group.

support-ana: Informing AcmePay now: will tell them we're investigating, ETA 30m.

deploybot: Deploy action queued: rollback kernel-selector on canary group us-east-canary-02. Start: 1789123478

maya: After rollback we'll compare p95. If baseline returns, bisect plan: toggle kernel-selector, kv-cache ttl, auth middleware change one at a time across small cohorts.

lee: Added tracing on token-validation path and a short-lived span id `tokval.slow` to help bisect.

ivan: If rollback doesn't help, we may hotpatch to short-circuit token validation for cached tokens (low-risk change) + add circuit breaker.

support-ana: :thumbsup: monitoring logs & will post customer updates. Will attach slow request logs.

lee: Example slow req log:
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:34Z] r_0a1b2c tenant=AcmePay path=/v1/generate latency=512ms kvcache_hit=false auth_validate=queued(32ms) backend_call=460ms
```

maya: Decision: Rollback kernel-selector in us-east NOW; apply per-tenant TTL override for AcmePay; owner: lee (rollback/config), ivan (override + followup), maya (triage lead), support-ana (customer comms). Will reconvene in 30m.

support-ana: update: rollback confirmed, p95 trending down to ~140ms at 1789123538. continuing to monitor.
